statement: First increment B (owner authorisation 2026-10-21): general English grammar the N0 shadow model reads to tell an object's role in a request and the stance a negated or modal clause takes towards an aspect. Grammar, not domain knowledge: no product, category or feature word. Negation scope, clause boundaries and indifference predicates are NOT repeated here: they come from quantity-knowledge language.en.scope through src/language_scope.ts.
notes: 'without' counts as unwanted, not excluded: 'a machine without a milk frother' states a wish whose strength is not given (owner decision 2 of the N0 design review).
A request verb before an object in its clause makes it requested even after a possessive ('my next dishwasher' is requested, not owned).

governed.note: after a negator or before a negated indifference predicate, the object phrase is the next (or previous) content words, skipping these function words; a phrase no reader types is kept as an unknown item with its stance (NR §8 X14)
